annotations.title: Revenue, expenses and profit by month

description: Revenue (výnosy, class 6), expenses (náklady, class 5) and profit per month from the general ledger — the same basis as the UOL web dashboard, so payroll, rent and other internal documents count, not just invoices. Amounts are net of VAT, in the home currency. The current month is still running, and months the accountant has not booked yet have booked=false — say so instead of reporting zero. Also returns the largest revenue and expense accounts (with names) for the whole window.
